allow: Bash(node -e "const p = require\('./public/data/places.json'\); const ids = p.features.map\(f=>f.properties.id\); const dupes = ids.filter\(\(x,i\)=>ids.indexOf\(x\)!==i\); console.log\('features:', ids.length, 'dupes:', dupes\); const bad = p.features.filter\(f=>!f.properties.title||!f.properties.year||!f.properties.category||f.geometry.coordinates.length!==2\); console.log\('invalid:', bad.length\);")

Bash(node -e "const t=require\('./public/data/trips.json'\); const p=require\('./public/data/places.json'\); const ids=new Set\(p.features.map\(f=>f.properties.id\)\); for \(const trip of t.trips\){ const missing=trip.stops.filter\(s=>!ids.has\(s\)\); if\(missing.length\) console.log\(trip.id,'MISSING:',missing\);} console.log\('trips:',t.trips.length,'all stop ids validated'\);")
